name: UNSW-NB15: Network Intrusion Detection Dataset
description: The UNSW-NB15 dataset is a comprehensive network security benchmark created in the Cyber Range Lab of UNSW Canberra using the IXIA PerfectStorm tool. It contains realistic contemporary normal network traffic and 9 modern attack families (Fuzzers, Analysis, Backdoors, DoS, Exploits, Generic, Reconnaissance, Shellcode, and Worms) described by 49 network flow features.
